constraintsHonored: No write to smartcity-os or smartcity-dashboards.
No widening of coverage claims in code or copy beyond counties the store actually holds -- the inverse risk (this exact widening) is precisely why every candidate was ruled out rather than shipped.

No write to a repository not owned by this lane (repo: legacy-design-tools) -- the only viable derivation path found requires a new endpoint in hauska-engine, and that work was recommended (CP2.designRecommendationForWhenUnblocked) rather than performed.
No hardcoded/declared county list shipped, even though three already exist elsewhere in the codebase and reusing one would have been the fast path -- explicitly the trap the dispatch warns against.
Did not conflate this finding with the separate, already-known located-unbound / address-point gap (six-of-254-counties address-point loading) -- untouched, not this lane's mandate.
falsifier: Pre-registered per dispatch: (1) does a coverage refusal false-fire inside one of the six onboarded counties? (2) does it fail to fire for a county the store demonstrably has zero rows for? (3) does the coverage check pass on an empty result that could be empty for an unrelated reason (a presence-shaped check)? Since no code shipped, (1) is vacuously not applicable. (2) is TRUE today and remains true: the live Killeen/Bell probe still returns bare no-hit (bug unfixed, correctly reported as still-open rather than silently accepted). (3) FIRED against the retrieval-api gate-verdict candidate (200/null indistinguishable from 'unevaluated rail' or 'read failure') and, separately, a live-evidence falsifier fired against the txgio_parcel-presence candidate: a real hit in Bexar County (48029, not a serving-ledger county) proves that store's row-presence is not equivalent to serving-ledger membership.
contradicted: Working premise going into CP1 was that 'derive coverage from what the store actually holds' would resolve to a query legacy-design-tools could already run (per the dispatch's own hint that this should be achievable on the read path). Live evidence contradicted this: the one store this repo can query directly (txgio_parcel/txgio_address) demonstrably holds broader-than-served coverage (Bexar hit), and the one external store reachable by HTTP (the Factory ledger via retrieval-api) has no existence-check endpoint, only an ambiguous per-rail verdict lookup. The dispatch's own escape hatch ('if you cannot derive it ... that reason is a finding') is the operative clause, not the main path.

missionPremise: OPS-24 P-205's ruling (this dispatch, 2026-09-14): a Texas county absent from the six-county serving ledger must return an honest coverage-class refusal from find_parcel instead of the ordinary no-hit an in-coverage genuine miss gets, and 'coverage must be DERIVED, never declared' -- a hardcoded county list is explicitly named as the failure mode to avoid, with an explicit carve-out that an undeliverable derivation is itself a valid, reportable finding rather than grounds to hardcode around the constraint.
completionPredicate: Closed (not blocked) requires: a live find_parcel call against an unonboarded Texas county returns a coverage-class miss naming the county/state, a live call against an onboarded county's genuine miss still returns plain no-hit (no regression), the served vocabulary carries the new/widened class, and the classification is backed by a query against a store that actually reflects serving-ledger membership -- not a hand-maintained list and not a table whose footprint has been shown broader than the ledger. None of these were reachable without new work outside this lane's owned repo, so this stays blocked rather than closed or closed-partial (closed-partial would misstate that partial customer-facing progress shipped; none did).
scopeBasis: Repo scope is 'legacy-design-tools' per this dispatch's PLAN-ROW line, and the dispatch's own Do-not list forbids writing to a repository this lane does not own. The only technically sound derivation found requires a new endpoint in hauska-engine, owned by a different lane/repo -- excluded on that basis, not because the work is undesirable or because it was overlooked; CP2 names the exact shape for whoever picks it up next. The separate located-unbound / address-point coverage gap (six-of-254 counties) is explicitly named out of scope by the dispatch itself ('That is a different gap and it is not yours') and was not touched.
